ADDICTION.NAME: Addiction
ADDICTION.DROP_DRUG: Drag a drug item here to record a dose and request an addiction save.
ADDICTION.NO_DRUGS: No drug items found. Drag a drug here or use Manual Entry.
ADDICTION.INVALID_DRUG: Choose an item with the drug trait.
ADDICTION.MISSING_DC: This drug has no readable Fortitude DC. Enter its addiction save DC.
ADDICTION.HINT: Drag a drug item or choose one below. Its name and Fortitude DC are read automatically. Manual Entry is available for custom drugs. Drug use suppresses addiction symptoms for one day and requests an addiction save. Track the drug’s poison separately. Use the same drug name for future doses. Inventory is not consumed.

SETTINGS.ENABLE_ADDICTION_RULES_HINT: Enable per-drug addiction history, relapse, weekly recovery, and one-day symptom suppression. Disabled by default. Turning off pauses addiction automation and hides drug-use controls; existing records and effects remain until removed by the GM.
SETTINGS.POISON_SUCCESS_STAGE_ONE_NAME: House Rule: Poison on Successful Initial Save
SETTINGS.POISON_SUCCESS_STAGE_ONE_HINT: An initial success against a new poison applies it with a maximum stage of 1. Critical success avoids it. Failed re-exposure removes the cap and advances normally. Onset and recovery still apply.
SETTINGS.ADJUST_AFFLICTION_DAMAGE_HINT: Adjust affliction damage by +2 for an Elite source creature or -2 for a Weak source creature. Disable to roll the base damage. Applies to newly generated damage cards and persistent damage; existing chat cards keep their formulas.
SETTINGS.EDITED_AFFLICTIONS_HINT: View and manage all customized affliction definitions
SETTINGS.SHOW_INDICATORS_HINT: Display biohazard icon on tokens with active afflictions
SETTINGS.AUTO_DETECT_HINT: Automatically detect poison/disease/curse items and prompt for initial saves
SETTINGS.AUTO_PROMPT_SAVES_HINT: Automatically prompt for saves when game time elapses outside combat
SETTINGS.STORYFRAME_HINT: Send save and counteract rolls through Storyframe module
SETTINGS.REQUIRE_CONFIRMATION_HINT: Require GM confirmation before applying save consequences (allows hero point rerolls)
SETTINGS.ANONYMIZE_SAVES_HINT: Hide affliction details in player save messages. Players see only "Fortitude Save Required" without affliction name, stage, or effects. Works with automatic unidentified effects to keep afflictions mysterious.
SETTINGS.GM_ROLL_MYSTERIOUS_HINT: GM rolls initial saves for mysterious afflictions (onset or no stage 1 mechanical effects). Players never see the save request, maintaining complete secrecy.
SETTINGS.USE_APP_INITIATIVE_HINT: When enabled, affliction saves trigger on the same initiative step the affliction was first applied, rather than the afflicted token's own initiative. Unofficial rule — not explicitly stated in the PF2e rulebook.
SETTINGS.USE_TOKEN_TOOLS_BUTTON_HINT: Move the Affliction Manager button from the Token HUD to the Token Tools sidebar. The button appears only when a token is selected and glows red when the selected token has active afflictions.
SETTINGS.COMMUNITY_DATA_VERSION_HINT: Version of community afflictions data last imported
SETTINGS.PROMPT_COATING_DURATION_HINT: When enabled, the GM is prompted to choose how long each weapon coating lasts. When disabled, all coatings last indefinitely until consumed.
SETTINGS.ALLOW_PLAYER_WEAPON_COATING_ACCESS_NAME: Allow Players to Use Weapon Coatings Tab
SETTINGS.ALLOW_PLAYER_WEAPON_COATING_ACCESS_HINT: Lets players open a limited Affliction Manager view for tokens they own. They can use the Weapon Coatings tab only; affliction management remains GM-only.
